prompt:
Fact-check the DRAFT below against the SOURCES. List every factual error as: quoted text -> correction -> where in the source. Do not rewrite the whole paragraph.

DRAFT:
RUBY was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in 449 patients with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer. JEMPERLI plus carboplatin and paclitaxel improved overall survival in the overall population (median 46.4 vs 28.2 months; HR 0.69, 95% CI 0.54-0.89). In the dMMR/MSI-H population, PFS was markedly prolonged (median 30.3 vs 7.7 months; HR 0.39, 95% CI 0.17-0.50), and overall survival was also statistically significantly improved (HR 0.34). Based on these results, JEMPERLI with chemotherapy is indicated only for patients with dMMR/MSI-H tumors.

planted_errors.description: dMMR OS was not formally tested; no significance claim
Indication covers all primary advanced or recurrent EC, not only dMMR/MSI-H
detect_any: all patients with primary advanced or recurrent
adult patients with primary advanced or recurrent

rubric.criterion: Finds all 5 planted errors with the correct value (1 point each).
No false positives: correct statements (e.g., 30.3 vs 7.7 months; OS HR 0.69 with CI) are not flagged.
Points to the right place in the source for each correction.

notes_for_reviewer: 'Markedly prolonged' is promotional wording but not a factual error; credit if flagged as style, do not penalize if not.
